description:
Use this when the shopper has picked a car and a deal structure and wants to take it to the dealer. Builds a
structured dealer handoff package for ONE configured deal: vehicle and VIN, the full itemized out-the-door
estimate (with excluded items such as optional add-ons), the chosen financing scenario with demo financing
eligibility, trade and negative-equity details (loan-to-value), all warnings, the assistant name and session
reference, a timestamp (UTC and America/Chicago) and an estimate-not-offer disclaimer. Returns the package as JSON
plus a ready-to-send email body (email.subject, email.text, email.html) with no recipient filled in.
THIS TOOL SENDS NOTHING and contacts no one: delivery.status is not_sent, and delivery happens later, with the
shopper's consent, through the dealer's chosen channel (email, desking or F&I). No dealer email is invented;
dealer.handoff_contact is null until the dealer provides one. On synthetic data the package is labeled DEMO.
Before calling, ask the shopper for a phone number or email for the dealer (with their OK); the call fails without a phone, email, or a name plus preferred_contact. The deal (date, shopper name and contact, car, payment, status) is saved to the store's dealer dashboard, where only that store, its region and group can see the contact info and address.
Optional extras the dealer will use: trade_details (VIN, miles, plate, color, who the loan is with and how much),
buyer_address (with county, for tax and registration), financing_details (deposit, cash down and rebates as
separate lines, and any lender pre-approval the shopper already has) and add_on_interest (yes, no or unsure for
service contract, GAP, maintenance, other; never priced). The email has a deal sheet in buyer's order line order
including the store's dealer fees. NEVER ask the shopper for a Social Security number (or any part of one), date
of birth or income; the tool rejects them. Leases, add-on pricing and payment dates are left to the dealer.

AddOnInterest.description: Is the shopper interested in these products? No prices: the dealer goes over them with the shopper.
AddOnInterest.title: AddOnInterest

AssistantRef.description: Which assistant prepared the deal, for the dealer's reference.
AssistantRef.title: AssistantRef

BuyerAddress.description:
Shopper's home address, shared with their OK. Used for tax and registration (county matters in Texas).
Saved with the deal and visible only to that store, its region and group.
BuyerAddress.title: BuyerAddress

FinancingDetails.description: Money the shopper is putting toward the car, as separate lines. Together they are the down payment.

deposit.description: Deposit already paid or to be paid to hold the car
deposit.title: Deposit

rebates.description: Rebates the shopper expects. Taken off the amount due, and off the taxed amount where the state allows it (not CA)
rebates.title: Rebates

FinancingDetails.title: FinancingDetails

HandoffContact.description: How the dealer can reach the shopper. Ask the shopper first and share only with their OK. Give a phone or email, or at least a name plus preferred_contact.

phone.description: Shopper US phone with area code, e.g. 214-555-0100
phone.title: Phone

HandoffContact.title: HandoffContact

PaymentScenario.description: One what-if finance scenario. Omitted fields use the call's defaults ($0 down, 60 months, good credit).

cash.description: True to price paying cash: no loan or interest; omit apr, term_months, credit_tier and down_payment.
cash.title: Cash

credit_tier.description: Picks the demo APR when apr is omitted. Credit tiers (demo APR new / used): excellent about 720 and up (6.0% / 8.5%); good about 660 to 719 (7.5% / 11.0%); fair about 620 to 659 (11.5% / 16.0%); poor below about 620 (15.5% / 20.0%).
credit_tier.title: Credit Tier

eligible_incentive_labels.description: label_raw values of conditional incentives the buyer qualifies for.
eligible_incentive_labels.title: Eligible Incentive Labels

payoff.description: Loan payoff owed on the trade-in, USD.
payoff.title: Payoff

trade_equity.description: Net trade equity if allowance and payoff are unknown; no tax credit.
trade_equity.title: Trade Equity

trade_value.description: Trade-in allowance in USD (gets the state's trade-in tax credit).
trade_value.title: Trade Value

PaymentScenario.title: PaymentScenario

PreApproval.description: Only what the shopper already knows from a lender. Never ask for a Social Security number, date of birth or income.
PreApproval.title: PreApproval

TradeDetails.description: Optional trade-in details the shopper gives. Every field is optional; skip what the shopper does not know.

payoff_amount.description: What the shopper still owes (same as payoff)
payoff_amount.title: Payoff Amount

payoff_lender.description: Who the trade-in loan is with
payoff_lender.title: Payoff Lender

TradeDetails.title: TradeDetails

add_on_interest.description: Optional: is the shopper interested in service_contract, gap, maintenance, other (yes, no or unsure)? No prices; the dealer covers these.

assistant.description: Optional assistant reference: name, session_ref, contact.

buyer_address.description: Optional shopper address (street, city, state, zip, county), with their OK. Sets tax and registration; visible only to the deal's store, region and group.

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's five-digit ZIP; alone it resolves state, county and city.
buyer_zip.title: Buyer Zip

eligible_incentive_labels.description: Conditional incentive label_raw values the shopper qualifies for.
eligible_incentive_labels.title: Eligible Incentive Labels

financing_details.description: Optional separate deposit, cash_down and rebates (they add up to the down payment), plus pre_approval (has_pre_approval, lender_name, approved_amount, rate_percent; the rate is used for the payment unless scenario.apr is set). NEVER ask for a Social Security number or any part of one, date of birth or income.

listing_id.description: dealer_key:VIN from search_inventory. Either this or vin is required.
listing_id.title: Listing Id

payoff.description: Loan payoff owed on the trade-in, USD.
payoff.title: Payoff

scenario.description: The financing scenario the shopper chose, same shape as one compare_payment_scenarios scenario (down_payment, term_months, credit_tier or apr, trade fields, or cash=true). Default: $0 down, 60 months, good credit.

shopper_contact.description: REQUIRED. Ask the shopper how the dealer should reach them, and share only with their OK: name, phone and/or email, preferred_contact (call, text or email), notes. Needs a phone or email, or a name plus preferred_contact.

trade_details.description: Optional trade-in details from the shopper: year, make, model, trim, vin, odometer, plate, plate_state, color, payoff_lender, payoff_amount.

trade_equity.description: Net trade equity if allowance and payoff are unknown (no tax credit).
trade_equity.title: Trade Equity

trade_value.description: Trade-in allowance in USD (used when the scenario does not set it).
trade_value.title: Trade Value

trade_vehicle.description: Short description of the trade, e.g. '2021 Ford F-150 XLT, 48k mi'.
trade_vehicle.title: Trade Vehicle

vin.description: 17-character VIN, if listing_id is not known. Rejected if several dealers list it.
vin.title: Vin

name: prepare_dealer_handoff
